name: Nikolai
self_text: Hi! I'm Nikolai, a non-binary Egyptian in my mid 20s. When I'm not sketching buildings, which I find incredibly relaxing, I'm usually on my console playing Skyforge Arena. I mainly queue for casual matches and play a damage role. I communicate over text chat while playing. I'm looking for someone to coach me. I am free Saturday afternoon or Sunday morning.

requests.request_text: I need you to play a damage role or a support role, and you have to be into casual matches. It's a deal-breaker unless you are available Saturday afternoon or Sunday morning. I'd strongly prefer that you are the one who coaches me, though it's not a requirement. Additionally, it would be nice if we overlap on text chat, but no big deal.
